notes.claim: Substitution turns two equations in two variables into one equation in one variable.
The substitution step puts the expression for one variable into the other equation.

sources.title: 5.2 Solve Systems of Equations by Substitution - Elementary Algebra | OpenStax
sources.quote: Step 2. Substitute the expression from Step 1 into the other equation.

sources.title: 4.1 Solve Systems of Linear Equations with Two Variables - Intermediate Algebra 2e | OpenStax
sources.quote: When we solved a system by substitution, we started with two equations and two variables and reduced it to one equation with one variable.
